source: User YbSLAM target specification; YAG data imported from repository Yb-YAG/ at origin/main 7aa9904.

material.name: Yb:YAG
material.lifetime_status: Korner2012 model/normalization parameter; not measured tau(T,20 at.%)
material.thermal_conductivity_status: Cini2017 HT 300 K doping-resistivity interpolation, held constant in explicit near-RT proxy assembly.

optics.wavelength_status: 969 nm ZPL pump from the user's YbSLAM target specification; 1030 nm signal design center. The former 938 nm exploratory pump remains selectable. Pump linewidth and exact source spectra are unmeasured.

geometry.disk_thickness_status: proposal method on page 12; overall preparation range 100-200 um
geometry.pump_beam_diameter_status: proposal preliminary thermal model on page 11; Gaussian 1/e2 diameter assumed here

pump.incident_average_power_status: exploratory assumption; proposal gives intensity below 10 kW/cm2 but no pump power
pump.relay_efficiency_status: idealized; no measured pump relay loss

seed.source_duration_status: adjustable placeholder requested by user; proposal does not state a femtosecond duration
seed.amplifier_duration_status: adjustable chirped-pulse placeholder; proposal calls the amplifier seed picosecond but does not specify duration
seed.signal_traversals_status: proposal phase budget quotes ten passes; actual optical relay layout is unspecified

targets.note: The proposal contains both <5 K design target and ~40 K preliminary surface variation; neither is a measured value.

coatings.status: proposal requirements; not measured coating curves
